settings.heading: Makeup that is half skincare.
settings.lede: We set out to make color you can wear all day and still feel good about when you wash it off.

settings.quote: Good makeup should feel like a favorite sweater: easy, flattering, and kind to you.
settings.note: A working makeup artist with sensitive skin built the first formulas in a small lab, then tested every one on faces like her own.

settings.heading: Clinically checked color, not just color.
settings.text: Every formula gets tested for results as well as payoff. We report the numbers, show the actives, and keep the claims to what the studies support.

settings.title: Polished, not painted
settings.text: Good makeup, not no makeup. Look put together while still looking like yourself.

settings.title: Color made simple
settings.text: Our founder learned color mixing in a portrait class, which is why shades blend on the first pass.

settings.title: Built for sensitive skin
settings.text: Each product is dermatologist-tested on reactive skin before it launches.

settings.title: Clean past the lists
settings.text: We go beyond popular banned-ingredient lists with our own, longer one.

settings.title: Comfort you can feel
settings.text: Light textures that let skin breathe, from morning to night.

settings.image_alt: Skincare actives in small glass dishes
settings.heading: Skin-friendly from the first ingredient.
settings.text: We exclude thousands of ingredients and publish the full list for every product and shade, so you can read what you are putting on your face.

settings.heading: Get launches before anyone else
settings.message: Early shade drops, offers and quick looks. One email a week at most.
